title: CytoCV: Web-based platform for reproducible yeast microscopy image analysis
organization_logo_alt: UW Bothell School of STEM logo
home_summary: Built by UW Bothell School of STEM’s SEE Lab for the University of Utah Miller Lab, CytoCV is a Django platform using Mask R-CNN to segment yeast microscopy stacks and export per-cell fluorescence measurements.
profile_summary: UW Bothell School of STEM’s SEE Lab built CytoCV for the University of Utah Miller Lab to automate yeast microscopy image analysis.
detail_summary: Built a Django and JavaScript platform for the University of Utah Miller Lab with REST APIs, deterministic batch ML processing, PostgreSQL data storage, and Linux VM deployment for 15+ scientists.
impact: Reduced manual analysis by 97%, cut processing time by 73%, and reduced file storage by 56.6%.
bullets: Architected Python Django REST APIs and a JavaScript Fetch API frontend|Built TensorFlow/Keras Mask R-CNN segmentation workflows with OpenCV scikit-image and NumPy|Extracted 30+ cell-level metrics from microscopy data|Migrated SQLite to PostgreSQL and optimized storage by converting TIFF caches to PNG|Led a 6-person Agile team and maintained CI/CD deployment on a UW-IT Linux VM

title: Adversarial Machine Learning: Analysis of Causative Attacks against SVMs Learning from Data Streams
organization_logo_alt: UW Bothell School of STEM logo
home_summary: Experimental study of targeted training-data poisoning against SVMs learning from streams, testing whether attacks can evade loss-based anomaly filtering and whether a feature-space stability metric can detect decision-boundary manipulation.
detail_summary: Used Python, TensorFlow/Keras, NumPy, and Matplotlib to automate attack and defense testing while tracking success rates, latency, and accuracy.
impact: Optimized batched Keras defense execution to under 5 seconds while preserving 94% clean-data accuracy.
bullets: Implemented attack and defense workflows for image classification models|Automated experiment reporting for success rates latency and accuracy|Improved defense execution with batched Keras evaluation

title: Guide Donor Scheduler: Yeast DNA target selection automation
organization_logo_alt: UW Bothell School of STEM logo
home_summary: Python sequence-design pipeline for yeast CRISPR/Cas9 experiments that selects 20-base guides near NGG PAMs, builds 132-base donor sequences around requested mutations, adds silent edits to prevent re-cutting, and exports XLS results.
detail_summary: Used Python, pandas, Biopython, and regex to analyze 18,000+ FASTA files and export validated sequences to Excel.
bullets: Built automated target selection workflows for yeast DNA research|Analyzed 18,000+ FASTA files with Python pandas Biopython and regex|Exported validated sequence results for researchers
